summary: 31-year-old Aspen man disappeared at the Independence Punch Bowl, a deep pool in the Roaring Fork River off Highway 82 (mile marker 50); his vehicle, clothes and personal belongings were found at the pull-off. A SARDOC handler with two canines indicated he was in the river, but high water (over 2,800 cfs) made it too dangerous for divers; he was located several weeks later when the waters receded, about a mile below where he was last seen.
location: Independence Punch Bowl, Roaring Fork River (Hwy 82 MM 50)
notes: Date Sunday-verified. SARDOC mission report: both canines alerted at the Punch Bowl and again after being restarted downstream; river too high for divers; subject located weeks later ~1 mi below PLS when runoff receded.
